title: Operation
description: One Action, performed by one role on one target. It inherits the Action's contract. A workflow is written over Operations, so the same Action can appear in it twice with different roles.

id.description: Kebab-case. Unique among the Operations of its behaviour document. all is reserved.

actor.description: The role that performs it at this point: a role of this behaviour document, or domain/role for one of a domain whose behaviour document this one uses. When the Action declares actors, it is one of them. Who fills the role is the organization's business.

target.description: What it is performed on. Defaults to the Action's entity.

actionRef.description: An Action in this behaviour document, or behaviour/action for one in a behaviour document this one uses.

entity.description: An entity id in the described domain, or domain/entity for one in a domain it uses.

instance.description: One named instance of that entity, such as a specific team.
